vo_open.text: And the disasters of both its sister ships.

vo.text: In 1911, she was a stewardess on the Olympic, when it collided with a British warship.
vo.cap: *1911:* stewardess on the *Olympic.* It hit a *British warship.*

vo.text: Seven months later, she was on the Olympic's sister ship. The Titanic.
vo.cap: 7 months later: its sister ship. *The Titanic.*

vo.text: As it sank, an officer handed her a baby to look after, in lifeboat sixteen.
vo.cap: In *lifeboat 16*, an officer handed her *a baby.*

vo.text: In 1916, she served on the third sister, the Britannic. It sank too.
vo.cap: *1916:* the third sister, *Britannic.* It sank too.

vo.text: She jumped from her lifeboat, as the propellers shredded the boats around her.
vo.cap: She jumped, as the propellers *shredded the lifeboats.*

vo.text: She kept working at sea, and lived to eighty-three.
vo.cap: She kept working at sea... and lived to *83.*
